narrative.overview:
One white sheet per billing package on a warm bone desk. Everything clean stays ink on paper; exceptions are marked the way a senior accountant marks them, in red pen. The reviewer should be able to look only at what needs them, and the surface earns that by staying quiet everywhere else.

The working surfaces (tables, the review queue, forms) are plain grotesk and standard controls. The paper-and-serif voice is held to display moments: one Newsreader sentence per screen, section titles, and verbatim contract quotes. Density is calm but not sparse: hairline rules separate sections inside a sheet instead of nested boxes.

Rejected: the KPI-tile dashboard with charts and coloured cards.
keyCharacteristics: Bone ground, white sheets, near-black ink, warm hairline rules.
Colour appears only as state, never as decoration.
Geist for all UI and every number; Newsreader only for display lines and quotes.
One focal money figure per screen, dollars large, cents small.
Two signature moves: the red-pen strike and the SIGNED rubber stamp.

rules.name: The Colour Is State Rule
rules.body: Colour only ever means state: redpen = not allowed / caught, amber = needs you, green = passes / ready. Everything else is paper and ink. A coloured element with no state behind it is a bug.

rules.name: The Word Too Rule
rules.body: State is never carried by colour alone; every badge and dot sits beside a word that says the state.

rules.name: The Ink-For-Text Rule
rules.body: On tints, text uses the -ink step (green-ink, amber-ink, redpen-ink); the bright stroke step is for dots, bars and the pen line.

rules.name: The Serif For Moments Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears only in display lines, section titles, the wordmark, and verbatim contract quotes. Tables, queues, forms, buttons and money are always Geist.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: A display line carries at most one italic phrase, set in ink-2, and it is the qualifier ("*and filed*", "*Nothing needs you.*"), never the subject.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount renders from integer cents through the Money component with tabular, lining figures, right-aligned in tables. Negative uses a true minus or parentheses.

rules.name: The 375 Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls the page horizontally at 375px. Wide tables scroll inside their own frame (Table `minWidth`), never the page.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Every tap target is at least 44px tall below sm; desktop may drop to 32 to 40px.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only sheet and float exist. Print drops both.

dos: **Do** keep clean lines ink on paper and spend colour only on state (redpen, amber, green).
**Do** say every state in words next to its colour.
**Do** open each screen with one Newsreader sentence, at most one italic accent in ink-2.
**Do** render every amount through Money, tabular, from integer cents; one focal amount per screen.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px below sm and let wide tables scroll inside their own frame at 375px.
**Do** play the strike and the stamp once, and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use AI sparkle icons or "magic" decoration for Steward's work.
**Don't** put kicker or eyebrow labels (small uppercase tracked text) above headings; labels are sentence case.
**Don't** use coloured side borders to flag rows or cards.
**Don't** build KPI tiles, charts or coloured cards.
**Don't** set tables, forms, buttons or money in Newsreader.
**Don't** nest a sheet inside a sheet, or add shadows beyond sheet and float.
